High contrast, rough brush energy but crisp and correctly formed text.
Subject: this is a results roundup, not an individual player story. Use a large hand-inked orange basketball at the right over a few abstract half-court line segments and one diagonal lime brush stroke. Ball fully inside canvas. No people, faces, hands, uniforms, team emblems, sponsors, logos, photos, arena reconstruction or specific game-winning-shot scene.
Layout: generous 5% outer margins; upper-left small brand and game date; left two-thirds dominant headline on two lines; the large '1' in lime with the rest of the victory headline ivory, strongly legible on a phone. Score below on a clean dark area. One medium secondary line about the article's daily EFF rankings. Right one-third contains the basketball illustration without colliding with text.
